## Problem / motivation

What gap or pain point is this addressing? Who benefits?

## Proposed solution

A clear, concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've thought about and why they fall short.

## Additional context

Mockups, links to similar features in other Tetris clones, references to the Tetris guideline, etc.
